examples.text: Münster ist eine der fahrradfreundlichsten Städte Deutschlands, aber Kopenhagen in Dänemark ist noch fahrradfreundlicher.
examples.translation: Munster is one of the most bike friendly cities in Germany, but Copenhagen in Denmark is even more bike friendly.
examples.english: Munster is one of the most bike friendly cities in Germany, but Copenhagen in Denmark is even more bike friendly.
